flags.reason: Japanese attributive that must be tested with a noun to distinguish from standalone 460.
Existing classifier hold retained; grammatical counter mistranslated as desk/counter.
Overlong mixed-register reassurance list; Indonesian Siapa Takut means who's afraid rather than no need to worry. Needs concise contextual rewrite.
Like very much confused with likeable, capable, passive being-liked, and literal like-as. Rewrite as a consistent preference construction.
Degree adverb very and adjective difficult are separate grammatical uses requiring context.
Existing particle hold retained; as is not a general equivalent of only.
Existing plural suffix hold retained; translate a complete plural phrase.
Vertical dimension たて is not arbitrary length; use vertical/height context.
Near distance and short length are not interchangeable; narrow to near/close.
Be different versus become different and purpose/future syntax need correction in an explicit construction.
Spurious question mark between alternatives.
Bowl for rice versus bowl containing rice; define container context to avoid testing contents as object.
Exactly/just-right confused with correct, merely, or only. Choose quantity/time context.
Spurious punctuation and agaknya means apparently rather than somewhat.
Malformed repeated parentheses and duplicated synonyms; simplify to become tired with natural verb forms.
Generic take is not an adequate isolated translation of つける; narrow to turn-on or another explicit object/action.
Work for an employer needs employment context; purpose/infinitive fragments and Thai go-to-work are not equivalent.
Spurious question mark between alternatives.
Adhesive tape versus audio tape/recording sense diverges across languages; select intended object.
Ability confused with achievement and purpose clause; use can-do construction.
Abbreviation note applies only to Japanese and is inherited by generated directions; move it to metadata.
